int hundredths(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    fraction := 0
    if #parts > 1
        fraction = int(if #parts[1] == 1 then parts[1] + "0" else parts[1])
    return 100 * int(parts[0]) + fraction

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := text.split(NL)
    if #lines > 0 and lines[-1] == ""
        lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]
    return lines

class Group(int number, string name, int[] values)
class Paired(int[] before, int[] after)
    differences := after - before

class Settings(local string[] lines)
    seed := 0
    bootstrap := 0
    permutations := 0
    confidence := 0
    pilot := 0
    power_sims := 0
    power_perms := 0
    bins := 0
    string[][] comparisons := []
    for line := lines[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "compare"
            comparisons = comparisons.append(fields[1:<#fields])
        elif fields[0] == "seed"
            seed = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "bootstrap"
            bootstrap = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "permutations"
            permutations = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "confidence"
            confidence = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "pilot"
            pilot = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "power"
            power_sims = int(fields[1])
            power_perms = int(fields[2])
        else
            bins = int(fields[1])

class Dataset(Group[] groups, Paired paired, Settings settings, int[][] pairs)

Dataset load()
    Group[] groups := []
    rows := read_lines("input/samples.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#rows)
        fields := rows[i].split(",")
        position := -1
        for: j < int(#groups)
            if groups[j].name == fields[0]
                position = j
                break
        if position < 0
            position = int(#groups)
            groups = groups.append(Group(position + 1, fields[0], []))
        groups[position].values = groups[position].values.append(hundredths(fields[1]))
    int[] before := []
    int[] after := []
    paired_rows := read_lines("input/paired.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#paired_rows)
        fields := paired_rows[i].split(",")
        before = before.append(hundredths(fields[1]))
        after = after.append(hundredths(fields[2]))
    settings := Settings(read_lines("input/params.txt"))
    int[][] pairs := []
    for comparison := settings.comparisons[]
        int[] indices := []
        for name := comparison[]
            for: i < int(#groups)
                if groups[i].name == name
                    indices = indices.append(i)
                    break
        pairs = pairs.append(indices)
    return Dataset(groups, Paired(before, after), settings, pairs)

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import minstd = "./minstd.qui"
import resampling = "./resampling.qui"
import tests = "./tests.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class Summary(real64 estimate, real64[] values, local int[] ranks)
    real64[] ordered := values.sorted()
    local spread := resampling.MeanSe(values)
    real64 average := spread.average
    real64 se := spread.se
    bias := average - estimate
    real64 low := ordered[ranks[0] - 1]
    real64 high := ordered[ranks[1] - 1]
    basic_low := 2.0 * estimate - high
    basic_high := 2.0 * estimate - low

    string csv_line(string name, string statistic)
        fields := [estimate, se, bias, low, high, basic_low, basic_high]
        return [name, statistic].concat([for field := fields[] then report.real_text(field)]).join(",")

    string interval_text()
        return "se {report.real_text(se)} bias {report.real_text(bias)} percentile {report.real_text(low)} {report.real_text(high)} basic {report.real_text(basic_low)} {report.real_text(basic_high)}"

class GroupBootstrap(dataset.Group group, int[][] indices, local int[] ranks)
    int[][] samples := [for replicate := indices[] then group.values[replicate]]
    local estimates := resampling.statistics(group.values)
    local replicates := [for sample := samples[] then resampling.statistics(sample)]
    Summary[] summaries := [for i := (0:<4)[] then Summary(estimates[i], [for replicate := replicates[] then replicate[i]], ranks)]

class PairBootstrap(GroupBootstrap first, GroupBootstrap second, local int[] ranks)
    string name := first.group.name + "-" + second.group.name
    local estimates := resampling.pair_statistics(first.group.values, second.group.values)
    local replicates := [for i := (0:<int(#first.samples))[] then resampling.pair_statistics(first.samples[i], second.samples[i])]
    Summary[] summaries := [for i := (0:<4)[] then Summary(estimates[i], [for replicate := replicates[] then replicate[i]], ranks)]

class Spread(local real64[] values)
    local count := int(#values)
    real64 average := values.sum() / real64(count)
    local offsets := values - average
    real64 variance := real64(count - 1) * (offsets * offsets).sum() / real64(count)

class Jackknife(local real64 estimate, real64[] values)
    local spread := Spread(values)
    real64 average := spread.average
    real64 variance := spread.variance
    bias := real64(int(#values) - 1) * (average - estimate)
    real64 se := math.sqrt(variance)

class Tally(int observed)
    extreme := 0
    greater := 0

    void .count(int value)
        if math.abs(value) >= math.abs(observed)
            extreme += 1
        if value >= observed
            greater += 1

    string text(int offset, int denominator)
        return "extreme {extreme} greater {greater} p_two {report.p_value(extreme + offset, denominator)} p_greater {report.p_value(greater + offset, denominator)}"

class DisplayRange(local int[] values)
    int low := values.min()
    int delta := 100 * (values.max() - low)

    int position(int value)
        return (120 * (value - 100 * low) + delta) / (2 * delta)

string[] group_names()
    return ["mean", "median", "trimmed_mean", "sd"]

string[] pair_names()
    return ["mean_diff", "median_ratio", "hodges_lehmann", "cohen_d"]

int[] outlier_indices(int[] values)
    first := resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 25)
    third := resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 75)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#values))[] if 200 * values[i] < 5 * first - 3 * third or 200 * values[i] > 5 * third - 3 * first then i]

void fill_band(string[] &band, int start, int end, string symbol)
    for: start <= i <= end
        band[i] = symbol

string box_plot(int[] values, DisplayRange display, int[] outliers, int[] whiskers)
    band := array(61, fill = ".")
    fill_band(&band, display.position(100 * whiskers[0]), display.position(100 * whiskers[1]), "-")
    fill_band(&band, display.position(resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 25)), display.position(resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 75)), "=")
    band[display.position(resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 50))] = "|"
    for index := outliers[]
        band[display.position(100 * values[index])] = "o"
    return band.join("")

string[] stem_lines(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    string[] lines := []
    for: ordered[0] / 100 <= stem <= ordered[-1] / 100
        leaves := [for value := ordered[] if value / 100 == stem then "{value % 100 / 10}"].join("")
        lines = lines.append(if #leaves == 0 then "stem {stem}" else "stem {stem} {leaves}")
    return lines

string[] series_lines(string kind, string name, int[] values, DisplayRange display, bool with_stems)
    count := int(#values)
    average := resampling.mean(values)
    deviation := resampling.sd(values)
    moments := resampling.central_moments(values)
    clipped := resampling.winsorized(values)
    first_quartile := resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 25)
    third_quartile := resampling.quantile_numerator(values, 75)
    outliers := outlier_indices(values)
    outside := array(#values, fill = false)
    for index := outliers[]
        outside[index] = true
    inside := [for i := (0:<count)[] if not outside[i] then values[i]]
    whiskers := [inside.min(), inside.max()]
    percentiles := [5, 10, 90, 95]
    labels := ["p05", "p10", "p90", "p95"]
    percentile_text := [for i := (0:<4)[] then "{labels[i]} {report.real_text(real64(resampling.quantile_numerator(values, percentiles[i])) / 10000.0)}"].join(" ")
    lines := [
        "{kind} {name}",
        "n {count}",
        "mean {report.real_text(average)}",
        "median {report.real_text(resampling.median(values))}",
        "trimmed_mean {report.real_text(resampling.trimmed_mean(values))} trim {count / 10}",
        "winsorized_mean {report.real_text(resampling.mean(clipped))} winsorized_sd {report.real_text(resampling.sd(clipped))}",
        "sd {report.real_text(deviation)}",
        "se_mean {report.real_text(deviation / math.sqrt(real64(count)))}",
        "cv {report.real_text(deviation / average)}",
        "skewness {report.real_text(moments[1] / (moments[0] * math.sqrt(moments[0])))}",
        "kurtosis {report.real_text(moments[2] / (moments[0] * moments[0]) - 3.0)}",
        "mad {report.real_text(resampling.mad(values))}",
        "min {report.real_text(real64(values.min()) / 100.0)}",
        "q1 {report.real_text(real64(first_quartile) / 10000.0)}",
        "q3 {report.real_text(real64(third_quartile) / 10000.0)}",
        "iqr {report.real_text(real64(third_quartile - first_quartile) / 10000.0)}",
        "max {report.real_text(real64(values.max()) / 100.0)}",
        "percentiles {percentile_text}",
        "whiskers {report.real_text(real64(whiskers[0]) / 100.0)} {report.real_text(real64(whiskers[1]) / 100.0)}",
        "outliers {report.number_list(outliers + 1)}",
        "box {box_plot(values, display, outliers, whiskers)}"
    ]
    return if with_stems then lines.concat(stem_lines(values)) else lines

real64 bca_alpha(real64 z0, real64 acceleration, real64 z)
    return resampling.phi(z0 + (z0 + z) / (1.0 - acceleration * (z0 + z)))

int[][] omitted_replicates(int[][] indices, int size)
    bool[][] selected := []
    for replicate := indices[]
        used := array(nat(size), fill = false)
        for index := replicate[]
            used[index] = true
        selected = selected.append(used)
    return [for i := (0:<size)[] then [for j := (0:<int(#indices))[] if not selected[j][i] then j]]

string[] pair_jackknife_lines(PairBootstrap pair)
    x := pair.first.group.values
    y := pair.second.group.values
    first_values := [for i := (0:<int(#x))[] then resampling.pair_statistics(resampling.without(x, i), y)]
    second_values := [for i := (0:<int(#y))[] then resampling.pair_statistics(x, resampling.without(y, i))]
    names := pair_names()
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < 4
        estimate := pair.summaries[i].estimate
        first := Jackknife(estimate, [for row := first_values[] then row[i]])
        second := Jackknife(estimate, [for row := second_values[] then row[i]])
        bias := first.bias + second.bias
        se := math.sqrt(first.variance + second.variance)
        lines = lines.append("pair {pair.name} {names[i]} estimate {report.real_text(estimate)} bias {report.real_text(bias)} se {report.real_text(se)}")
    return lines

string welch_line(int[][] samples)
    count := int(#samples)
    means := [for sample := samples[] then resampling.mean(sample)]
    real64[] weights := []
    for sample := samples[]
        deviation := resampling.sd(sample)
        weights = weights.append(real64(#sample) / (deviation * deviation))
    total := weights.sum()
    center := (weights * means).sum() / total
    offsets := means - center
    spread := (weights * (offsets * offsets)).sum() / real64(count - 1)
    real64[] terms := []
    for: i < count
        share := 1.0 - weights[i] / total
        terms = terms.append(share * share / real64(int(#samples[i]) - 1))
    lambda := terms.sum()
    f := spread / (1.0 + real64(2 * (count - 2)) * lambda / real64(count * count - 1))
    df := real64(count * count - 1) / (3.0 * lambda)
    return "welch f {report.real_text(f)} df {count - 1} {report.real_text(df)}"

class PairResult(string[] lines, int[] extremes)

class Study(dataset.Dataset source, local minstd.Generator &bootstrap_generator)
    dataset.Settings settings := source.settings
    int low_rank := (settings.bootstrap + 1) * (100 - settings.confidence) / 200
    int[] ranks := [low_rank, settings.bootstrap + 1 - low_rank]
    real64 z_low := resampling.phi_inverse(real64(100 - settings.confidence) / 200.0)
    GroupBootstrap[] ordinary := []
    for group := source.groups[]
        ordinary = ordinary.append(GroupBootstrap(group, resampling.ordinary_indices(&bootstrap_generator, int(#group.values), settings.bootstrap), ranks))
    GroupBootstrap[] balanced := []
    for group := source.groups[]
        balanced = balanced.append(GroupBootstrap(group, resampling.balanced_indices(&bootstrap_generator, int(#group.values), settings.bootstrap), ranks))
    local real64[] initial_mean_values := []
    local real64[] initial_correlation_values := []
    for replicate := resampling.ordinary_indices(&bootstrap_generator, int(#source.paired.differences), settings.bootstrap)[]
        initial_mean_values = initial_mean_values.append(resampling.mean(source.paired.differences[replicate]))
        initial_correlation_values = initial_correlation_values.append(resampling.correlation(source.paired.before[replicate], source.paired.after[replicate]))
    mean_summary := Summary(resampling.mean(source.paired.differences), initial_mean_values, ranks)
    correlation_summary := Summary(resampling.correlation(source.paired.before, source.paired.after), initial_correlation_values, ranks)
    PairBootstrap[] pairs := [for pair := source.pairs[] then PairBootstrap(ordinary[pair[0]], ordinary[pair[1]], ranks)]

    string[] descriptive_file()
        int[] everything := []
        for group := source.groups[]
            everything = everything.concat(group.values)
        lines := ["groups {#source.groups} observations {#everything}"]
        display := DisplayRange(everything)
        for group := source.groups[]
            lines = lines.concat(series_lines("group", group.name, group.values, display, true))
        dataset.Paired paired := source.paired
        lines = lines.append("paired subjects {#paired.differences}")
        paired_display := DisplayRange(paired.before.concat(paired.after))
        lines = lines.concat(series_lines("series", "before", paired.before, paired_display, false))
        lines = lines.concat(series_lines("series", "after", paired.after, paired_display, false))
        return lines.concat(series_lines("series", "diff", paired.differences, DisplayRange(paired.differences), false))

    string[] bootstrap_file()
        lines := ["group,statistic,estimate,se,bias,percentile_lo,percentile_hi,basic_lo,basic_hi"]
        names := group_names()
        for: i < int(#ordinary)
            for: j < 4
                lines = lines.append(ordinary[i].summaries[j].csv_line(ordinary[i].group.name, names[j]))
            for: j < 4
                lines = lines.append(balanced[i].summaries[j].csv_line(balanced[i].group.name, "balanced_" + names[j]))
        comparisons := pair_names()
        for pair := pairs[]
            for: j < 4
                lines = lines.append(pair.summaries[j].csv_line(pair.name, comparisons[j]))
        return lines

    string[] histogram_lines(string name, string statistic, Summary summary)
        bins := settings.bins
        low := summary.values.min()
        high := summary.values.max()
        counts := array(nat(bins), fill = 0)
        for value := summary.values[]
            counts[report.bin_number(value, low, high, bins) - 1] += 1
        top := counts.max()
        string[] empty_marks := []
        string[][] marks := array(nat(bins), fill = empty_marks)
        lower := report.bin_number(summary.low, low, high, bins) - 1
        marks[lower] = marks[lower].append("L")
        estimate_bin := "none"
        if low <= summary.estimate <= high
            position := report.bin_number(summary.estimate, low, high, bins)
            estimate_bin = "{position}"
            marks[position - 1] = marks[position - 1].append("E")
        upper := report.bin_number(summary.high, low, high, bins) - 1
        marks[upper] = marks[upper].append("H")
        string[] convergence := []
        for: 1 <= quarter <= 4
            size := quarter * settings.bootstrap / 4
            spread := resampling.MeanSe(summary.values[0:<size])
            convergence = convergence.append("{size}:{report.real_text(spread.se)}")
        lines := ["histogram {name} {statistic} min {report.real_text(low)} max {report.real_text(high)} width {report.real_text((high - low) / real64(bins))} top {top} estimate_bin {estimate_bin}", "convergence " + convergence.join(" ")]
        for: i < bins
            edge := low + (high - low) * real64(i) / real64(bins)
            parts := ["bin", "{i + 1}", report.real_text(edge), "{counts[i]}"]
            if counts[i] > 0
                parts = parts.append(report.bar(counts[i], top))
            lines = lines.append(parts.concat(marks[i]).join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] histogram_file()
        string[] lines := []
        names := group_names()
        for bootstrap := ordinary[]
            for: i < 4
                lines = lines.concat(histogram_lines(bootstrap.group.name, names[i], bootstrap.summaries[i]))
        comparisons := pair_names()
        for pair := pairs[]
            for: i < 4
                lines = lines.concat(histogram_lines(pair.name, comparisons[i], pair.summaries[i]))
        return lines

    string bca_line(string statistic, Summary summary, Jackknife jackknife)
        count := settings.bootstrap
        below := [for value := summary.values[] if value < summary.estimate then 1].sum()
        z0 := resampling.phi_inverse(real64(below) / real64(count))
        differences := jackknife.average - jackknife.values
        square_sum := (differences * differences).sum()
        cube_sum := (differences * differences * differences).sum()
        real64 acceleration := cube_sum / (6.0 * square_sum * math.sqrt(square_sum))
        lower_raw := math.floor(real64(count + 1) * bca_alpha(z0, acceleration, z_low))
        upper_offset := math.floor(real64(count + 1) * (1.0 - bca_alpha(z0, acceleration, -z_low)))
        lower := math.min(math.max(lower_raw, 1), count)
        upper := math.min(math.max(count + 1 - upper_offset, 1), count)
        return "bca {statistic} below {below} z0 {report.real_text(z0)} acceleration {report.real_text(acceleration)} ranks {lower} {upper} interval {report.real_text(summary.ordered[lower - 1])} {report.real_text(summary.ordered[upper - 1])}"

    string[] after_bootstrap_lines(GroupBootstrap bootstrap, Jackknife mean_jackknife)
        values := bootstrap.group.values
        count := int(#values)
        omitted := omitted_replicates(bootstrap.indices, count)
        real64[][] errors := []
        for summary := bootstrap.summaries[]
            real64[] column := []
            for numbers := omitted[]
                spread := resampling.MeanSe(summary.values[numbers])
                column = column.append(spread.se)
            errors = errors.append(column)
        string[] lines := []
        names := group_names()
        for: i < 4
            spread := Spread(errors[i])
            lines = lines.append("after_bootstrap {names[i]} se {report.real_text(bootstrap.summaries[i].se)} average {report.real_text(spread.average)} se_of_se {report.real_text(math.sqrt(spread.variance))}")
        sizes := [for numbers := omitted[] then int(#numbers)]
        lines = lines.append("without min {sizes.min()} max {sizes.max()}")
        total := values.sum()
        int[] ranking := []
        for: i < count
            position := int(#ranking)
            ranking = ranking.append(i)
            while position > 0 and math.abs(count * values[i] - total) > math.abs(count * values[ranking[position - 1]] - total)
                ranking[position] = ranking[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            ranking[position] = i
        for: rank < 5
            index := ranking[rank]
            influence := real64(count - 1) * (mean_jackknife.average - mean_jackknife.values[index])
            real64[] shifted := (bootstrap.summaries[0].values[omitted[index]] - bootstrap.summaries[0].estimate).sorted()
            string[] quantiles := []
            for percent := [5, 50, 95][]
                position := (percent * sizes[index] + 99) / 100
                quantiles = quantiles.append(report.real_text(shifted[position - 1]))
            lines = lines.append("influence {rank + 1} obs {index + 1} value {report.real_text(real64(values[index]) / 100.0)} l {report.real_text(influence)} without {sizes[index]} se {report.real_text(errors[0][index])} q05 {quantiles[0]} q50 {quantiles[1]} q95 {quantiles[2]}")
        return lines

    string[] group_jackknife_lines(GroupBootstrap bootstrap)
        values := bootstrap.group.values
        replicates := [for i := (0:<int(#values))[] then resampling.statistics(resampling.without(values, i))]
        jackknives := [for i := (0:<4)[] then Jackknife(bootstrap.summaries[i].estimate, [for row := replicates[] then row[i]])]
        lines := ["group {bootstrap.group.name} n {#values}"]
        names := group_names()
        for: i < 4
            summary := bootstrap.summaries[i]
            jackknife := jackknives[i]
            lines = lines.append("jackknife {names[i]} estimate {report.real_text(summary.estimate)} average {report.real_text(jackknife.average)} bias {report.real_text(jackknife.bias)} se {report.real_text(jackknife.se)}")
        for: i < 4
            lines = lines.append(bca_line(names[i], bootstrap.summaries[i], jackknives[i]))
        return lines.concat(after_bootstrap_lines(bootstrap, jackknives[0]))

    string[] jackknife_file()
        string[] lines := []
        for bootstrap := ordinary[]
            lines = lines.concat(group_jackknife_lines(bootstrap))
        for pair := pairs[]
            lines = lines.concat(pair_jackknife_lines(pair))
        return lines

    PairResult permutation_lines(int[] x, int[] y, minstd.Generator &generator)
        permutations := settings.permutations
        int[] combined := x.concat(y)
        rank_values := tests.doubled_ranks(combined)
        positions := 0:<int(#combined)
        observed := tests.split_statistics(combined, rank_values, positions, int(#x))
        tallies := [for value := observed[] then Tally(value)]
        for: replicate < permutations
            order := positions
            .generator.shuffle(&order)
            statistics := tests.split_statistics(combined, rank_values, order, int(#x))
            for: i < 4
                .tallies[i].count(statistics[i])
        k := int(#x)
        m := int(#y)
        rank_total := rank_values[0:<k].sum()
        results := [for tally := tallies[] then tally.text(1, permutations + 1)]
        lines := [
            "permutation n {k} {m} perms {permutations}",
            "mean diff {report.real_text(resampling.mean_difference(x, y))} {results[0]}",
            "median diff {report.real_text(real64(observed[1]) / 200.0)} {results[1]}",
            "ranksum w {report.real_text(real64(rank_total) / 2.0)} u {report.real_text(real64(rank_total - k * (k + 1)) / 2.0)} {results[2]}",
            "absdev diff {report.real_text(real64(observed[3]) / real64(200 * k * m))} {results[3]}"
        ]
        return PairResult(lines, [for tally := tallies[] then tally.extreme])

    bool simulation_rejects(int[] first, int[] second, minstd.Generator &generator)
        k := int(#first)
        m := int(#second)
        int[] combined := first.concat(second)
        total := combined.sum()
        observed := math.abs(tests.contrast(first.sum(), k, second.sum(), m))
        count := 0
        for: replicate < settings.power_perms
            shuffled := combined
            .generator.shuffle(&shuffled)
            head := shuffled[0:<k].sum()
            if math.abs(tests.contrast(head, k, total - head, m)) >= observed
                count += 1
        return 100 * (count + 1) <= (100 - settings.confidence) * (settings.power_perms + 1)

    string power_line(int[] x, int[] y, minstd.Generator &generator)
        rejections := 0
        for: replicate < settings.power_sims
            int[] first := x[resampling.resample_indices(&generator, int(#x))]
            int[] second := y[resampling.resample_indices(&generator, int(#y))]
            if simulation_rejects(first, second, &generator)
                rejections += 1
        power := real64(rejections) / real64(settings.power_sims)
        se := math.sqrt(power * (1.0 - power) / real64(settings.power_sims))
        return "power sims {settings.power_sims} perms {settings.power_perms} rejections {rejections} power {report.real_text(power)} se {report.real_text(se)}"

    string critical_line(int[] mean_values, int size, int splits)
        tests.ValueCount[] counts := tests.value_counts([for value := mean_values[] then math.abs(value)])
        critical := -1
        cumulative := 0
        attained := 0
        for: int(#counts) - 1 >= i >= 0
            cumulative += counts[i].count
            if 100 * cumulative > (100 - settings.confidence) * splits
                break
            critical = counts[i].value
            attained = cumulative
        if critical < 0
            return "critical diff none attained none"
        return "critical diff {report.real_text(real64(critical) / real64(100 * size * size))} attained {report.p_value(attained, splits)}"

    string[] exact_lines(int[] x, int[] y)
        size := settings.pilot
        int[] combined := x[0:<size].concat(y[0:<size])
        rank_values := tests.doubled_ranks(combined)
        total := combined.sum()
        int[] mean_values := []
        int[] ranks_values := []
        for choice := tests.position_choices(2 * size, size)[]
            int chosen := combined[choice].sum()
            mean_values = mean_values.append(tests.contrast(chosen, size, total - chosen, size))
            ranks_values = ranks_values.append(rank_values[choice].sum() - size * (2 * size + 1))
        splits := int(#mean_values)
        mean_tally := Tally(mean_values[0])
        rank_tally := Tally(ranks_values[0])
        for: i < splits
            .mean_tally.count(mean_values[i])
            .rank_tally.count(ranks_values[i])
        rank_total := rank_values[0:<size].sum()
        difference := resampling.mean_difference(x[0:<size], y[0:<size])
        return [
            "exact size {size} splits {splits}",
            "mean diff {report.real_text(difference)} {mean_tally.text(0, splits)}",
            "ranksum w {report.real_text(real64(rank_total) / 2.0)} u {report.real_text(real64(rank_total - size * (size + 1)) / 2.0)} {rank_tally.text(0, splits)}",
            critical_line(mean_values, size, splits)
        ]

    string[] studentized_lines(PairBootstrap pair)
        x := pair.first.group.values
        y := pair.second.group.values
        k := int(#x)
        m := int(#y)
        estimate := resampling.mean_difference(x, y)
        first_sd := resampling.sd(x)
        second_sd := resampling.sd(y)
        first_variance := first_sd * first_sd / real64(k)
        second_variance := second_sd * second_sd / real64(m)
        se0 := math.sqrt(first_variance + second_variance)
        t := estimate / se0
        real64[] statistics := []
        for: i < settings.bootstrap
            first_replicate := pair.first.summaries[3].values[i]
            second_replicate := pair.second.summaries[3].values[i]
            spread := math.sqrt(first_replicate * first_replicate / real64(k) + second_replicate * second_replicate / real64(m))
            statistics = statistics.append((pair.summaries[0].values[i] - estimate) / spread)
        extreme := [for value := statistics[] if math.abs(value) >= math.abs(t) then 1].sum()
        ordered := statistics.sorted()
        lower := estimate - ordered[ranks[1] - 1] * se0
        upper := estimate - ordered[ranks[0] - 1] * se0
        degrees := (first_variance + second_variance) * (first_variance + second_variance) / (first_variance * first_variance / real64(k - 1) + second_variance * second_variance / real64(m - 1))
        greater := 0
        equal := 0
        for a := x[]
            for b := y[]
                if a > b
                    greater += 1
                elif a == b
                    equal += 1
        d := resampling.cohen_d(x, y)
        hedges := d * (1.0 - 3.0 / real64(4 * (k + m - 2) - 1))
        cles := real64(2 * greater + equal) / real64(2 * k * m)
        return [
            "bootstrap_t t {report.real_text(t)} df {report.real_text(degrees)} extreme {extreme} p {report.p_value(extreme + 1, settings.bootstrap + 1)} interval {report.real_text(lower)} {report.real_text(upper)}",
            "effect pooled_sd {report.real_text(resampling.pooled_sd(x, y))} cohen_d {report.real_text(d)} hedges_g {report.real_text(hedges)} cles {report.real_text(cles)}"
        ]

    PairResult pair_test_lines(PairBootstrap pair, minstd.Generator &generator)
        first := pair.first.group
        second := pair.second.group
        lines := ["compare {first.name} {second.name}"]
        PairResult permutation := permutation_lines(first.values, second.values, &generator)
        lines = lines.concat(permutation.lines)
        lines = lines.append(power_line(first.values, second.values, &generator))
        lines = lines.concat(exact_lines(first.values, second.values))
        return PairResult(lines.concat(studentized_lines(pair)), permutation.extremes)

    string[] holm_lines(int[][] extremes)
        permutations := settings.permutations
        count := int(#pairs)
        names := ["mean", "median", "ranksum", "absdev"]
        string[] lines := []
        for: column < 4
            values := [for pair_extremes := extremes[] then pair_extremes[column]]
            int[] order := []
            for: i < count
                position := int(#order)
                order = order.append(i)
                while position > 0 and values[i] < values[order[position - 1]]
                    order[position] = order[position - 1]
                    position -= 1
                order[position] = i
            adjusted := 0
            for: rank < count
                index := order[rank]
                extreme := values[index]
                adjusted = math.max(adjusted, math.min(permutations + 1, (count - rank) * (extreme + 1)))
                verdict := if 100 * adjusted <= (100 - settings.confidence) * (permutations + 1) then "reject" else "retain"
                first := pairs[index].first.group.name
                second := pairs[index].second.group.name
                lines = lines.append("holm {names[column]} rank {rank + 1} {first} {second} p {report.p_value(extreme + 1, permutations + 1)} adjusted {report.p_value(adjusted, permutations + 1)} {verdict}")
        return lines

    string[] paired_lines()
        int[] before := source.paired.before
        int[] after := source.paired.after
        int[] differences := source.paired.differences
        count := int(#differences)
        positive := [for difference := differences[] if difference > 0 then 1].sum()
        negative := [for difference := differences[] if difference < 0 then 1].sum()
        average := resampling.mean(differences)
        deviation := resampling.sd(differences)
        r := resampling.correlation(before, after)
        real64 z := 0.5 * math.log((1.0 + r) / (1.0 - r))
        real64 half_width := -z_low / math.sqrt(real64(count - 3))
        lower_growth := math.exp(2.0 * (z - half_width))
        upper_growth := math.exp(2.0 * (z + half_width))
        lower := (lower_growth - 1.0) / (lower_growth + 1.0)
        upper := (upper_growth - 1.0) / (upper_growth + 1.0)
        return [
            "paired subjects {count} positive {positive} negative {negative} zero {count - positive - negative}",
            "paired before {report.real_text(resampling.mean(before))} after {report.real_text(resampling.mean(after))} diff {report.real_text(average)} sd_diff {report.real_text(deviation)} t {report.real_text(average / (deviation / math.sqrt(real64(count))))} dz {report.real_text(average / deviation)}",
            "paired_bootstrap {mean_summary.interval_text()}",
            "correlation r {report.real_text(r)} {correlation_summary.interval_text()} fisher {report.real_text(lower)} {report.real_text(upper)}"
        ]

    string[] sign_flip_lines(minstd.Generator &generator)
        permutations := settings.permutations
        int[] differences := source.paired.differences
        signed := tests.signed_ranks(differences)
        mean_tally := Tally(differences.sum())
        rank_tally := Tally(signed.sum())
        for: replicate < permutations
            int[] signs := []
            for: i < int(#differences)
                signs = signs.append(if .generator.draw() % 2 == 1 then -1 else 1)
            .mean_tally.count((signs * differences).sum())
            .rank_tally.count((signs * signed).sum())
        w_plus := real64([for rank := signed[] if rank > 0 then rank].sum()) / 2.0
        return [
            "signflip flips {permutations}",
            "mean diff {report.real_text(resampling.mean(differences))} {mean_tally.text(1, permutations + 1)}",
            "signedrank w_plus {report.real_text(w_plus)} {rank_tally.text(1, permutations + 1)}"
        ]

    string[] anova_permutation_lines(int[] combined, int[] rank_values, int[] sizes, real64 f, real64 h, real64 correction, minstd.Generator &generator)
        permutations := settings.permutations
        group_count := int(#sizes)
        total_count := int(#combined)
        int[][] comparisons := []
        for: i < group_count
            for: i + 1 <= j < group_count
                comparisons = comparisons.append([i, j])
        tests.Delta[] observed := tests.group_deltas(tests.split_list(combined, sizes), comparisons)
        f_extreme := 0
        h_extreme := 0
        extremes := array(#comparisons, fill = 0)
        maxima := array(#comparisons, fill = 0)
        positions := 0:<total_count
        for: replicate < permutations
            order := positions
            .generator.shuffle(&order)
            parts := tests.split_list(order, sizes)
            int[][] samples := [for part := parts[] then combined[part]]
            squares := tests.sums_of_squares(samples)
            if tests.f_statistic(squares.between, squares.within, group_count, total_count) >= f - 0.000000001 * f
                f_extreme += 1
            int[] rank_sums := [for part := parts[] then rank_values[part].sum()]
            if tests.h_statistic(rank_sums, sizes, correction) >= h - 0.000000001 * h
                h_extreme += 1
            tests.Delta[] deltas := tests.group_deltas(samples, comparisons)
            largest := deltas[0]
            for: 1 <= i < int(#deltas)
                if not largest.at_least(deltas[i])
                    largest = deltas[i]
            for: i < int(#observed)
                if deltas[i].at_least(observed[i])
                    extremes[i] += 1
                if largest.at_least(observed[i])
                    maxima[i] += 1
        lines := ["anova_permutation perms {permutations} f_extreme {f_extreme} f_p {report.p_value(f_extreme + 1, permutations + 1)} h_extreme {h_extreme} h_p {report.p_value(h_extreme + 1, permutations + 1)}"]
        for: i < int(#comparisons)
            dataset.Group first := source.groups[comparisons[i][0]]
            dataset.Group second := source.groups[comparisons[i][1]]
            difference := resampling.mean_difference(first.values, second.values)
            lines = lines.append("pairwise {first.name} {second.name} diff {report.real_text(difference)} extreme {extremes[i]} p {report.p_value(extremes[i] + 1, permutations + 1)} maxt {maxima[i]} adjusted {report.p_value(maxima[i] + 1, permutations + 1)}")
        return lines

    string[] anova_lines(minstd.Generator &generator)
        int[][] samples := [for group := source.groups[] then group.values]
        sizes := [for sample := samples[] then int(#sample)]
        group_count := int(#samples)
        total_count := sizes.sum()
        squares := tests.sums_of_squares(samples)
        f := tests.f_statistic(squares.between, squares.within, group_count, total_count)
        eta := squares.between / (squares.between + squares.within)
        msw := squares.within / real64(total_count - group_count)
        omega := (squares.between - real64(group_count - 1) * msw) / (squares.between + squares.within + msw)
        real64[] eta_values := []
        for: i < settings.bootstrap
            replicate_squares := tests.sums_of_squares([for bootstrap := ordinary[] then bootstrap.samples[i]])
            eta_values = eta_values.append(replicate_squares.between / (replicate_squares.between + replicate_squares.within))
        eta_summary := Summary(eta, eta_values, ranks)
        int[] combined := []
        for sample := samples[]
            combined = combined.concat(sample)
        rank_values := tests.doubled_ranks(combined)
        rank_sums := [for part := tests.split_list(rank_values, sizes)[] then part.sum()]
        int[] ties := [for entry := tests.value_counts(combined)[] if entry.count >= 2 then entry.count]
        tie_total := (ties * ties * ties - ties).sum()
        correction := 1.0 - real64(tie_total) / real64(total_count * total_count * total_count - total_count)
        h := tests.h_statistic(rank_sums, sizes, correction)
        lines := [
            "anova groups {group_count} observations {total_count} ssb {report.real_text(squares.between)} ssw {report.real_text(squares.within)} df {group_count - 1} {total_count - group_count} f {report.real_text(f)} eta_squared {report.real_text(eta)} omega_squared {report.real_text(omega)}",
            "eta_bootstrap {eta_summary.interval_text()}",
            welch_line(samples),
            "kruskal h {report.real_text(h)} tie_groups {#ties}"
        ]
        return lines.concat(anova_permutation_lines(combined, rank_values, sizes, f, h, correction, &generator))

    string[] tests_file(minstd.Generator &generator)
        string[] lines := []
        int[][] extremes := []
        for pair := pairs[]
            PairResult result := pair_test_lines(pair, &generator)
            lines = lines.concat(result.lines)
            extremes = extremes.append(result.extremes)
        lines = lines.concat(holm_lines(extremes))
        lines = lines.concat(paired_lines())
        lines = lines.concat(sign_flip_lines(&generator))
        return lines.concat(anova_lines(&generator))

void run()
    data := dataset.load()
    generator := minstd.Generator(data.settings.seed)
    study := Study(data, &generator)
    test_lines := study.tests_file(&generator)
    file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("output/descriptives.txt", study.descriptive_file())
    report.write_lines("output/bootstrap.csv", study.bootstrap_file())
    report.write_lines("output/jackknife.txt", study.jackknife_file())
    report.write_lines("output/tests.txt", test_lines)
    report.write_lines("output/histograms.txt", study.histogram_file())

if main
    run()

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

    int .below(int limit)
        return .draw() % limit

    void .shuffle(int[] &items)
        for: int(#items) - 1 >= i >= 1
            j := .draw() % (i + 1)
            saved := items[i]
            items[i] = items[j]
            items[j] = saved

import math
import tests = "./tests.qui"

string real_text(real64 value)
    text := "{value:.4}"
    return if text == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else text

string p_value(int numerator, int denominator)
    fraction := tests.reduced_fraction(numerator, denominator)
    reduced_numerator := fraction[0]
    reduced_denominator := fraction[1]
    return "{reduced_numerator}/{reduced_denominator} {real_text(real64(reduced_numerator) / real64(reduced_denominator))}"

string number_list(int[] numbers)
    if #numbers == 0
        return "none"
    return [for value := numbers.sorted()[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

int bin_number(real64 value, real64 low, real64 high, int bins)
    index := math.floor(real64(bins) * (value - low) / (high - low))
    return math.min(index, bins - 1) + 1

string bar(int count, int top)
    return "#" * nat((40 * count + top - 1) / top)

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write(path)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import math
import minstd = "./minstd.qui"

real64 mean(int[] values)
    return real64(values.sum()) / real64(100 * int(#values))

int doubled_median(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    count := int(#values)
    return ordered[(count + 1) / 2 - 1] + ordered[(count + 2) / 2 - 1]

real64 median(int[] values)
    return real64(doubled_median(values)) / 200.0

real64 trimmed_mean(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    count := int(#values)
    trim := count / 10
    return real64(ordered[trim:<count - trim].sum()) / real64(100 * (count - 2 * trim))

real64[] deviations(int[] values)
    return real64(values) / 100.0 - mean(values)

real64 sd(int[] values)
    offsets := deviations(values)
    return math.sqrt((offsets * offsets).sum() / real64(int(#values) - 1))

real64[] central_moments(int[] values)
    offsets := deviations(values)
    count := real64(#values)
    return [(offsets * offsets).sum() / count, (offsets * offsets * offsets).sum() / count, (offsets * offsets * offsets * offsets).sum() / count]

real64 mad(int[] values)
    center := doubled_median(values)
    return real64(doubled_median([for value := values[] then math.abs(2 * value - center)])) / 400.0

int quantile_numerator(int[] values, int percent)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    position := (int(#values) - 1) * percent
    index := position / 100
    fraction := position - 100 * index
    if fraction == 0
        return 100 * ordered[index]
    return 100 * ordered[index] + fraction * (ordered[index + 1] - ordered[index])

int[] winsorized(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    trim := int(#values) / 10
    low := ordered[trim]
    high := ordered[#values - 1 - nat(trim)]
    return [for value := values[] then math.min(math.max(value, low), high)]

real64 mean_difference(int[] x, int[] y)
    k := int(#x)
    m := int(#y)
    return real64(m * x.sum() - k * y.sum()) / real64(100 * k * m)

real64 median_ratio(int[] x, int[] y)
    return real64(doubled_median(x)) / real64(doubled_median(y))

real64 hodges_lehmann(int[] x, int[] y)
    int[] differences := []
    for first := x[]
        differences = differences.concat([for second := y[] then first - second])
    return real64(doubled_median(differences)) / 200.0

real64 pooled_sd(int[] x, int[] y)
    first := sd(x)
    second := sd(y)
    squares := real64(int(#x) - 1) * first * first + real64(int(#y) - 1) * second * second
    return math.sqrt(squares / real64(int(#x) + int(#y) - 2))

real64 cohen_d(int[] x, int[] y)
    return mean_difference(x, y) / pooled_sd(x, y)

real64 correlation(int[] x, int[] y)
    first := deviations(x)
    second := deviations(y)
    return (first * second).sum() / math.sqrt((first * first).sum() * (second * second).sum())

real64[] statistics(int[] values)
    return [mean(values), median(values), trimmed_mean(values), sd(values)]

real64[] pair_statistics(int[] x, int[] y)
    return [mean_difference(x, y), median_ratio(x, y), hodges_lehmann(x, y), cohen_d(x, y)]

int[] resample_indices(minstd.Generator &generator, int size)
    int[] indices := []
    for: i < size
        indices = indices.append(.generator.below(size))
    return indices

int[][] ordinary_indices(minstd.Generator &generator, int size, int count)
    int[][] indices := []
    for: i < count
        indices = indices.append(resample_indices(&generator, size))
    return indices

int[][] balanced_indices(minstd.Generator &generator, int size, int count)
    int[] sequence := []
    for: i < count
        sequence = sequence.concat(0:<size)
    .generator.shuffle(&sequence)
    return [for i := (0:<count)[] then sequence[i * size:<(i + 1) * size]]

int[] without(int[] values, int index)
    return values[0:<index].concat(values[index + 1:<#values])

class MeanSe(local real64[] values)
    real64 average := values.sum() / real64(#values)
    offsets := values - average
    real64 se := math.sqrt((offsets * offsets).sum() / real64(int(#values) - 1))

real64 phi(real64 x)
    if x < 0.0
        return 1.0 - phi(-x)
    eta := 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.2316419 * x)
    psi := eta * (0.319381530 + eta * (-0.356563782 + eta * (1.781477937 + eta * (-1.821255978 + eta * 1.330274429))))
    return 1.0 - 0.3989422804014327 * math.exp(-(x * x) / 2.0) * psi

real64 phi_inverse(real64 p)
    if p > 0.5
        return -phi_inverse(1.0 - p)
    real64 eta := math.sqrt(-2.0 * math.log(p))
    numerator := 2.515517 + eta * (0.802853 + eta * 0.010328)
    denominator := 1.0 + eta * (1.432788 + eta * (0.189269 + eta * 0.001308))
    return -(eta - numerator / denominator)

import math
import resampling = "./resampling.qui"

class ValueCount(int value, int count)

int[] reduced_fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    first := numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return [numerator / first, denominator / first]

ValueCount[] value_counts(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    ValueCount[] counts := []
    for value := ordered[]
        if #counts == 0 or counts[-1].value != value
            counts = counts.append(ValueCount(value, 1))
        else
            counts[-1].count += 1
    return counts

int[] doubled_ranks(int[] values)
    counts := value_counts(values)
    int[] assigned := []
    smaller := 0
    for entry := counts[]
        assigned = assigned.append(2 * smaller + entry.count + 1)
        smaller += entry.count
    int[] ranks := []
    for value := values[]
        for: i < int(#counts)
            if counts[i].value == value
                ranks = ranks.append(assigned[i])
                break
    return ranks

int contrast(int first_total, int first_size, int second_total, int second_size)
    return second_size * first_total - first_size * second_total

int[][] position_choices(int total, int size)
    choice := 0:<size
    int[][] choices := []
    while true
        choices = choices.append(choice)
        index := size - 1
        while index >= 0 and choice[index] == total - size + index
            index -= 1
        if index < 0
            break
        choice[index] += 1
        for: index + 1 <= j < size
            choice[j] = choice[j - 1] + 1
    return choices

int[][] split_list(int[] items, int[] sizes)
    int[][] parts := []
    start := 0
    for size := sizes[]
        parts = parts.append(items[start:<start + size])
        start += size
    return parts

class Squares(real64 between, real64 within)

Squares sums_of_squares(int[][] samples)
    count := [for sample := samples[] then int(#sample)].sum()
    total := [for sample := samples[] then sample.sum()].sum()
    grand_mean := real64(total) / real64(100 * count)
    real64[] between_values := []
    real64[] within_values := []
    for sample := samples[]
        center := resampling.mean(sample)
        offset := center - grand_mean
        between_values = between_values.append(real64(#sample) * (offset * offset))
        real64[] deviations := real64(sample) / 100.0 - center
        within_values = within_values.append((deviations * deviations).sum())
    return Squares(between_values.sum(), within_values.sum())

real64 f_statistic(real64 between, real64 within, int groups, int count)
    return between / real64(groups - 1) / (within / real64(count - groups))

real64 h_statistic(int[] rank_sums, int[] sizes, real64 correction)
    count := sizes.sum()
    total := [for i := (0:<int(#sizes))[] then real64(rank_sums[i] * rank_sums[i]) / real64(4 * sizes[i])].sum()
    return (12.0 * total / real64(count * (count + 1)) - real64(3 * (count + 1))) / correction

int[] split_statistics(int[] values, int[] ranks, int[] order, int size)
    int[] first := values[order[0:<size]]
    int[] second := values[order[size:<#order]]
    k := int(#first)
    m := int(#second)
    first_center := resampling.doubled_median(first)
    second_center := resampling.doubled_median(second)
    first_deviation := [for value := first[] then math.abs(2 * value - first_center)].sum()
    second_deviation := [for value := second[] then math.abs(2 * value - second_center)].sum()
    return [contrast(first.sum(), k, second.sum(), m), first_center - second_center, ranks[order[0:<size]].sum() - k * (k + m + 1), contrast(first_deviation, k, second_deviation, m)]

int[] signed_ranks(int[] differences)
    magnitudes := [for difference := differences[] if difference != 0 then math.abs(difference)]
    ranks := doubled_ranks(magnitudes)
    position := 0
    int[] signed := []
    for difference := differences[]
        if difference == 0
            signed = signed.append(0)
        else
            signed = signed.append(if difference > 0 then ranks[position] else -ranks[position])
            position += 1
    return signed

class Delta(int numerator, int denominator)
    bool at_least(Delta bound)
        return numerator * bound.denominator >= bound.numerator * denominator

Delta[] group_deltas(int[][] samples, int[][] pairs)
    totals := [for sample := samples[] then sample.sum()]
    sizes := [for sample := samples[] then int(#sample)]
    return [for pair := pairs[] then Delta(math.abs(contrast(totals[pair[0]], sizes[pair[0]], totals[pair[1]], sizes[pair[1]])), sizes[pair[0]] * sizes[pair[1]])]
